name: Hexahedral
tagline: Drag the green cube. Thirty jam levels. Your best lives in the file.
description:
Works offline, no account, no install. Close it on level 18 and it opens on level 18 — this file keeps the level you reached and your best moves.

You are the green cube. Pink blocks are up, blue are down, beige are broken. Step onto a neighbour and it toggles. Push every pink down before you run out of moves. Drag the cube on a phone and it slides along the isometric faces; tap a neighbour; arrows work on a laptop. Undo if you step wrong.

Easy, medium, and hard — ten Global Game Jam levels each. Finish one and the next is waiting.

An unofficial port of Hexahedral by mminer. Same thirty puzzles; the Redux shell stays behind.
